newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 19.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 19.625 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates were steady on Wednesday in abundant money supply and moderate activity, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 19.625 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.
Since the beginning of the banks' two-week reserve period on August 1, overnight rates hovered in a narrow range between 19.50 and 20.00 percent.
The central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo facility stands at 20.00 percent and Tolonics added the situation was getting ripe for a 25 basis points repo rate cut.
